answer: A hostile operator running 161 aliases as a result needs 98 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in jade, expire in orchard, and umber lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 21 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3314 identities would post 1407 proofs and burn roughly 63 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
